# Cocktail From What I Have Skill for Muse

Answers "what can I actually make with the bottles already on my shelf?": from your real inventory (spirits, mixers, gear) it produces 2–3 cocktails you can make right now, with measurements, method (shaken/stirred/built), glassware, smart substitutions for missing ingredients, a batch note for serving a group, and a genuinely developed non-alcoholic version rather than juice in a glass. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it assumes you have at least a few bottles to work with — which is simply the premise of the concept.
